reason: Last year at home was cramped and forgettable, so I want a place with its own room, a theme and a proper workshop – EXTRA with eksperymenty or LEGO could give my kid and the class the wow I'm after. With 14-16 classmates it will cost me 1500-2000 zł, which I can afford if it actually looks good in photos.
objection: The animator only comes in the pricier package and every extra child costs 70 zł, so the 'from 550 zł' price is not the real price. A 7-8 year old might also find a sala zabaw too babyish, and banning my own cakes for adults feels like squeezing me.
would_change_my_mind: If photos from real parties for 7-8 year olds looked basic, or if my child said it's a place for little kids, I would not book.
